title: leucophysalis heterophylla
intro: Leucophysalis heterophylla, commonly known as the Mexican prickly poppy or Mexican thistle, is a plant species in the Solanaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its use in treating fever, colds, and other respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Leucophysalis heterophylla include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, although further research is required to confirm the specific compounds and their effects.
